q1.sampleAnswer: They plan to launch special satellites into orbit to broadcast the net across the Earth.

keyPoints.descZh: 计划发射特殊卫星进入轨道，向全球“播送”网络
examples: broadcast the net across the Earth

q1.rubricZh: 要点：发射特殊卫星进入轨道，把网络覆盖到全球。
q1.explanationZh: 第一段说大公司想让没有网络的人上网，办法是发射特殊的卫星，让卫星把网络“播送”到地球各处。

evidence.quote: They plan to launch special satellites into orbit

q2.sampleAnswer: Most things on the web are only available in a few languages, but there are thousands of different languages around the world.

keyPoints.descZh: 网上的大多数内容只有少数几种语言
examples: Most things on the web are only available in a few languages.

keyPoints.descZh: 世界上有成千上万种不同的语言
examples: There are thousands of different languages around the world.

q2.rubricZh: 要点：网上大多数内容只有少数几种语言；世界上却有成千上万种语言。
q2.explanationZh: 划线句说的“问题”在第二段：世界上有几千种语言，但网上的东西大多只有其中几种。

evidence.quote: There are thousands of different languages spoken around the world.
Most things on the web, however, are only available in a few of them.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because Facebook had only a few native editors in Myanmar for years.

keyPoints.descZh: 脸书多年来在缅甸只有很少的本地编辑
examples: Facebook had only a few native editors in Myanmar for years.

q3.rubricZh: 要点：脸书在缅甸多年来只有很少的本地编辑。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说脸书在缅甸多年只有几个本地编辑，没有好编辑，错误信息就在平台上传开了。

evidence.quote: The company had only a few native editors for years.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：两种较小（使用人数较少）的语言。
q4.explanationZh: 第四段说一些公司想把较小的语言带到网上，Common Voice 收集英语、德语，也收集僧伽罗语和约鲁巴语，所以它们是两种较小的语言。

evidence.quote: Some companies have been trying to bring smaller languages online.

q5.rubricZh: 要点：回答“No, they don’t.”（不能）。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一句说翻译像笑话这样的内容非常困难，甚至不可能，所以大公司的翻译程序并不能让翻译笑话更容易，回答 No。

evidence.quote: However, it is very difficult, if not impossible, to translate things like jokes.

q6.sampleAnswer: I think the gap can be closed by developing smarter translation programs and training more professional translators. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 提出一种缩小语言差距的可行办法
examples: We can develop smarter translation programs.

keyPoints.descZh: 办法具体、合理，与文章内容相关
examples: We can train more professional translators.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：先提出一个办法，再让办法具体合理。
q6.explanationZh: 这是观点题，没有唯一答案。可以说开发更好的翻译程序、培养更多翻译人员，或者像 Common Voice 那样收集小语种的语音。

evidence.quote: Some companies have been trying to bring smaller languages online.

q7.explanationZh: to this problem 前面需要名词，solve 的名词是 solution，意思是“解决办法”。

q8.explanationZh: product 后面要名词，develop 的名词是 development，product development 是“产品开发”。

q9.explanationZh: 主语 the twins 是复数，句子说双胞胎长得像但性格“不同”，用一般现在时，所以填 differ。
q9.tipsZh: differ 不同；different 是形容词

q10.explanationZh: 空格在句首，后面是 to the gas supply，要用名词，且首字母大写，所以填 Connection。

q11.explanationZh: some 后面接名词，而且 meet with some difficulties 常用复数，所以填 difficulties。

q12.explanationZh: “我不熟悉的”是定语从句，that 后面缺谓语；植物是复数，用过去式 were，be unfamiliar to sb. 是“对某人来说陌生”。
q12.tipsZh: be unfamiliar to sb. 对某人来说不熟悉

q13.explanationZh: “将不能”用 shall not be able to，后面接 attend（出席）。
q13.tipsZh: shall not be able to do sth. 将不能做某事

accept: The hospital is being forced to close

q14.explanationZh: “正被迫关闭”是现在进行时的被动语态，句首的主语是 the hospital，所以写 The hospital is being forced to close。
q14.tipsZh: be forced to do sth. 被迫做某事

q15.explanationZh: leaving 后面接宾语和宾语补足语：leave sb. to do sth. 表示“留下某人去做某事”，所以写 other companies to play catch-up。

accept: He has just founded his own business
He has just founded his own company
He has just founded his own firm

q16.explanationZh: “刚建立”用现在完成时 has just founded，“自己的公司”是 his own business/company/firm。
q16.tipsZh: have just done 刚刚做完
